controlledPublisherAfter.orchestration: one default measurement agent; no child agent, guardian, broad discovery, or publication mutation

limitations: The deterministic harness makes no model or provider call; model and timing observations come from the separate controlled publisher rollout.
Raw local rollout tokens are not billed API cost or exact subscription-credit consumption; cached input is included in raw input and reasoning output is included in output.
Request-start, first-token, and model-completion latency are not exposed by the rollout and remain null rather than being inferred.
The final controlled after-case completed without a clarification turn; the earlier superseded pilot and its digest-label correction are not used as final evidence.

Four pre-publication review rounds found merge-base glob, empty-blob, changed-files omission, authority-provenance laundering, and non-invariant affected-page deletion regressions. All findings were fixed before this successful controlled after-case and are not omitted from the implementation history.
The final publication review is a separate mandatory exact-HEAD gate and is not counted as part of this paired performance pilot.
